item.title: Le Grand rassemblement — 6th Edition
item.description: Come celebrate the 6th edition of this end-of-summer festival in one of the most beautiful spots in the Îles-de-la-Madeleine! Nestled between sea and cliffs, Anse aux Baleiniers opens its arms for a vibrant, festive celebration deeply rooted in Madelinot soul. Whether you’re a longtime islander or passing visitor, this festival is an invitation to fully experience the spirit of the Îles: the sea, the music, the laughter and unforgettable encounters. Don’t miss this final festive stop before autumn arrives!

item.title: Akadie 2000 Reunion Show
item.description: Come celebrate the richness and warmth of Acadian culture at our show in Fatima! This festive event honours music, dance, gastronomy and the traditions of the Acadian people, whose history is intimately tied to that of the Îles-de-la-Madeleine. Whether you’re Acadian or simply curious, come experience a colourful evening filled with infectious rhythms, regional flavours and warm encounters!

item.title: Little Whale Festival
item.description: Big and small, get ready for two magical days of play, laughter and creativity! The Children’s Festival, in its very first edition, offers activities and surprises at every turn — continuous entertainment, interactive games and hands-on fun throughout both days. Come live two days of family happiness with unforgettable memories. Bring your smile, your energy and your sunscreen!

item.title: Sécuri-Fête — Canadian Forces Snowbirds
item.description: On June 27 and 28, 2026, don’t miss two spectacular days of safety demonstrations and airshows featuring the legendary Canadian Forces Snowbirds! Watch these elite pilots perform breathtaking aerial maneuvers, showcasing extraordinary teamwork, discipline and skill. A must-see for aviation enthusiasts, families and anyone who admires Canadian excellence! Saturday, June 27 — 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM Public safety exhibitors including the Sûreté du Québec, fire department, ambulance service, Rangers and marine intervention teams.

item.title: Fête nationale Show in Fatima
item.description: Join us for a warm and festive evening celebrating Québec’s national holiday! Local artists will take the stage to make you sing, dance and feel the pride of home. Bring your chair, your flag and your biggest smile — and come share a memorable evening under the stars! Programme 8:45 PM — Opening ceremony 9:00 PM — Musical group “Bordasse” 9:30 PM — Bonfire 9:50 PM — Fireworks display 10:00 PM — 100% Québécois
